🛠️ **VIUMO Service Update**

We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused by some sections and features of VIUMO not working as expected.

We acknowledge these issues and deeply appreciate your patience and continued support. Improvements and fixes are currently underway, and we're working hard on a new update to make your VIUMO experience smoother and more reliable.

Thank you for growing with us—we truly appreciate having you on this journey! ❤️

— *The VIUMO Team
